items.question: How long does specialty leather processing take?
items.answer: Organic materials like leather and suede require careful conditioning over multiple stages. We typically request 7-10 business days to ensure a proper restoration.

items.question: Can you handle set-in stains?
items.answer: While we cannot guarantee the removal of heavily oxidized stains, our targeted spotting techniques successfully lift the vast majority of complex organic and chemical marks without harming the fabric.

items.question: What kind of solvents do you utilize?
items.answer: We rely on modern, environmentally conscious solvents that thoroughly cleanse garments without leaving residual chemical odors or harming the local ecosystem.

items.question: Do you provide tailoring alongside cleaning?
items.answer: Yes, our on-staff specialists perform routine maintenance like hemming and button replacement, as well as complex structural alterations.
